definition:
SELECT app_uuid('project'::text, label) AS id,
    (('PRJ-'::text || lpad(row_number() OVER (ORDER BY src.title)::text, 3, '0'::text)))::character varying(20) AS project_code,
    title::character varying(200) AS title,
    customer_name::character varying(200) AS customer_name,
    NULL::uuid AS lead_id,
    NULL::uuid AS feasibility_id,
    NULL::uuid AS costing_id,
    NULL::uuid AS costing_version_id,
    'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying(40) AS status,
    'MEDIUM'::character varying(20) AS priority,
    NULL::uuid AS project_manager_id,
    NULL::date AS start_date,
    NULL::date AS target_date,
    NULL::date AS completion_date,
    ''::text AS description,
    ''::text AS site_location,
    ''::text AS customer_contact,
    ''::text AS hold_reason,
    ''::text AS risk_reason,
    ''::text AS completion_remarks,
    NULL::numeric AS approved_value,
    NULL::uuid AS created_by,
    now() AS created_at,
    now() AS updated_at,
    ''::character varying(40) AS project_type,
    ''::character varying(100) AS department,
    ''::character varying(40) AS team_code,
    ''::character varying(30) AS assignment_type,
    NULL::uuid AS assigned_to_id,
    NULL::uuid AS assigned_team_id,
    ''::character varying(40) AS team_review_status,
    NULL::uuid AS team_reviewed_by,
    ''::text AS handover_notes,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS handover_at
   FROM ( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN btrim(COALESCE(tasks.project_name, ''::text)) = ''::text THEN 'internal work'::text
                    ELSE lower(btrim(tasks.project_name))
                END AS label,
                CASE
                    WHEN btrim(COALESCE(tasks.project_name, ''::text)) = ''::text THEN 'Internal work'::text
                    ELSE btrim(tasks.project_name)
                END AS title,
            COALESCE(max(NULLIF(btrim(tasks.customer_name), ''::text)), ''::text) AS customer_name
           FROM tasks
          GROUP BY (
                CASE
                    WHEN btrim(COALESCE(tasks.project_name, ''::text)) = ''::text THEN 'internal work'::text
                    ELSE lower(btrim(tasks.project_name))
                END), (
                CASE
                    WHEN btrim(COALESCE(tasks.project_name, ''::text)) = ''::text THEN 'Internal work'::text
                    ELSE btrim(tasks.project_name)
                END)) src;
